summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement for a $90 million senior notes offering. The notes carry a 9.600% coupon and mature in 2031, with a 30-day over-allotment option for an additional $13.5 million. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, KBW, Piper Sandler, RBC, UBS, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt issuance by the issuer, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, premium, or structural special-situation mechanics are present. There is no risk-arb angle; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
